description: Slop 4: four pitch-detuning channels, each with its own drift, over one shared hum and one shared drift

params.text: Scales the pitch passing through that channel; at the low end each octave comes out 0.2 semitones flat
Depth of a 60Hz vibrato applied equally to all four channels, reaching 12 cents peak at full
Depth of the slow random detuning that all four channels receive together
Depth of the slow random detuning each channel receives on its own

inputs.text: The pitch for that channel; with nothing patched the output carries the hum and the drift on their own

outputs.text: That channel's pitch with its tracking error, the shared hum, the shared drift and its own drift added

notes: the individual drift is always a shift in Hz, so it pulls low notes further out of tune than high ones
